title: fix(runtime): the config door registers a stack's declared api items into the metadata service
body:
Part of #22989
Clause-②: no

This lands the half of #22989 that the triage ruling directs: on a config boot, `AppPlugin` registers the stack's declared `api` items into the metadata service. The card stays open. Its own pin (`examples/app-showcase` on `os serve` answers 401) is **not** met by this change, and no change in `packages/runtime` can meet it. The showcase is a host config. On `os serve` its `metadata` slot holds the kernel's in-memory fallback (`createMemoryMetadata`, `packages/core`), which has no `matchEndpoint`, so no endpoint matcher exists on that boot. That half is an open question on the card, in the `os-dev-report` comment.

## What changes

`AppPlugin.start()` (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`) gains `registerDeclaredApiEndpoints`. It is called right after the code-defined datasource registration and does four things:

- It registers each declared `api` item into the metadata service through `registerInMemory`. Each item is stamped through `applyProtection` with the stack's own manifest coordinates (`artifactPackageId`, `version`). That is the route and the ADR-0010 stamp the code-defined datasources already take.
- It takes the items from the boot's one forward-converted copy, `this.forwardConverted(ctx).definition`. It never reads the raw bundle and never converts a second time. Each item is copied before the stamp, because `applyProtection` writes in place.
- Under `securityMetadataRegistrar: 'artifact-door'` it does nothing. This is the guard `registerUnclaimedTopLevel` uses, so on `os dev` and on an artifact boot the door stays the only registrar.
- It leaves a bundle that carries `packages[]` alone. `registerUnclaimedTopLevel` already registers that bundle's top-level residual, `api` included. A package body's item would need the body walk, which reads bodies that no conversion reaches.

Not touched: `packages/metadata` (`metadata-manager.ts`, `endpoint-matcher.ts`), `packages/spec`, `packages/plugins/*` and `packages/cli`. No second matcher is added.

**Owner of an `api` item.** It is the stack's manifest, as for a single-package datasource (`codeDefinedDatasourceOwners`, packages absent). The artifact door stamps the same pair on its single-package branch (ADR-0130 D7). Measured: the config door's stored item `toEqual`s the artifact door's stored item for the same stack, stamp included (the test below).

**Matcher order.** `EndpointMatcher` builds its index lazily, at the first `matchEndpoint`. `registerInMemory` invalidates the index (`invalidateListCache('api')` calls `endpointMatcher.invalidate()`, `metadata-manager.ts`). So no ordering is needed between `AppPlugin.start()` and the index build. The pins read the index after boot.

## Measured over HTTP, before and after

The request is a `GET` of the declared path with no session. "Before" for the showcase rows is the real BASE build (`4267484fe5`). "Before" for the scratch fixtures is this branch with `app-plugin.ts` restored to BASE bytes (blob `39d6bb3b69`, equal to BASE's) and runtime rebuilt; the dist marker count was 0. "After" is this branch. The undeclared control path `/api/v1/apps/NS/no-such` answered 404 on every boot.

| boot | metadata service | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `os serve objectstack.config.ts`, bare config fixture (one object, one `authRequired` api), no `dist/` | `MetadataManager` (`createStandaloneStack`, no artifact) plus the CLI's `new AppPlugin(config)` | 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | **401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`** |
| the same fixture after `os build` (artifact door) | `MetadataManager` over `dist/objectstack.json` | 401 | 401 |
| `os serve objectstack.config.ts`, a spread of `examples/app-todo` plus one api, no `dist/` | as row 1 | 404 | **401** |
| `os serve objectstack.config.ts`, `examples/app-showcase` (host config) | kernel in-memory fallback, no `matchEndpoint` | 404 | **404, unchanged.** The boot now logs `Registered stack-declared api endpoints … count: 2`, and nothing matches. |
| `os dev --fresh`, `examples/app-showcase` | dev artifact door, wrap declares `artifact-door` | 401 | 401. AppPlugin registers no api, so the door stays the only registrar. |
| showcase host config plus one `new MetadataPlugin({ watch: false })` (scratch config) | `MetadataManager`, no artifact | 404 | **401** |

The last row measures one way to finish the card's other half. With a `MetadataManager` composed beside it, this change is what makes the showcase answer 401 from source.

## Types the config door lacks (reported, not fixed)

These counts are `metadata.list(TYPE).length` at `kernel:ready` for every type the artifact door maps (`ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE`). They were taken on `examples/app-showcase` at this branch with a read-only probe plugin.

- **Config door** (`os serve`, fallback service, `matchEndpoint` absent): object 108, position 10, permission 9, capability 2, sharing_rule 2, api 2. Every other mapped type is 0.
- **Artifact door** (`os serve --dev`, door over `dist/objectstack.json`, `matchEndpoint` present): object 108, app 1, view 42, page 28, dashboard 3, report 4, action 71, flow 30, position 10, permission 9, capability 2, sharing_rule 2, api 2, webhook 1, hook 5, mapping 1, analytics_cube 1, connector 4, email_template 1, doc 8, book 1.
- **Held on the artifact door and absent on the config door:** app, view, page, dashboard, report, action, flow, webhook, hook, mapping, analytics_cube, connector, email_template, doc, book.
- Zero on both: object_extension, workflow, agent, tool, skill, rag_pipeline, picklist.

Not measured: whether any consumer reads one of these types only from the metadata service, the way the matcher reads `api`.

## Tests

`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin-config-door-api-items.test.ts`, 6 cases, at `133543eb42`:

- **Config door.** The fixture boots the composition `os serve` assembles for a bare config with no artifact (`createStandaloneStack` over an absent artifact path, plus `new AppPlugin(config)`). Pin: `matchEndpoint` resolves the declared `GET` to the declaration, the question `runAppEndpointStep` asks before it answers 401 or 404. The `POST` and undeclared-path controls stay misses.
- **Artifact door (CONTROL).** The same stack's compiled twin matches the same path.
- **Byte-comparable.** The config door's stored item equals the artifact door's stored item, `_packageId` / `_packageVersion` / `_provenance` included.
- **Exactly once (CONTROL).** With `MetadataManager.prototype.register` and `registerInMemory` spied, an artifact boot writes `api` `probe_task_feed` once through the door's `register`, and zero times through `registerInMemory`.
- **One conversion.** In a unit leg, the registered item is a stamped copy of the item `init()` handed the `manifest` service: not the same object, and `toEqual` to it plus the stamps. The manifest service's item carries no stamp.
- **`artifact-door` registrar.** The registrar registers no `api` item.

**Ablation.** Run with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which replaced the call line with a comment. Anchor count 1 -> 0, blob `c538f19090` -> `84eadb1af4`. The subject resolves from `src` through relative imports (`./app-plugin.js`, `./standalone-stack.js`), so no dist rebuild sits in this loop. With the line removed, 3 cases are red: the config-door match (`expected undefined to be 'probe_task_feed'`), the byte-comparable case (`undefined`) and the one-conversion case (`[]`). The 3 controls stay green. Restore: blob back to `c538f19090`, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Whole package, through the shared lock, at `133543eb42`:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files  358 passed (358)`, `Tests  5147 passed | 19 skipped (5166)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test (count 1). `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- The #22994 pins `app-plugin-converted-collections.test.ts` and `standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts`, run verbose beside the new file: `Test Files  3 passed (3)`, `Tests  27 passed (27)`.
- Regression check on the dogfood harness, whose `bootStack` composes the default registrar beside an artifact door: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/showcase-declarative-endpoints.dogfood.test.ts` gave `Tests  17 passed (17)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

**Lint, a proven narrowing** at `133543eb42`:
1. The population comes from eslint's own config: `--print-config` resolves a rule set for both touched TypeScript files (6 and 5 rules), and none for the `.md` changeset.
2. The count comes from `--format json`: `files=2 errors=0 warnings=0`.
3. Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting. Each of its 7 `parserOptions` blocks is `{ ecmaVersion, sourceType }`, with no `parserOptions.project`. Its only file reads are two baseline JSONs at config load, neither touched here. So this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Line 1 is `Part of`, not the dispatch's `Fixes`.** #22989 remains open after this merges: the card's pin on the showcase's `os serve` boot is unmet, and the remaining half waits on a decision.
- **Multi-package bundles.** A package body's `api` item is still not in the metadata service on the config door. The top-level residual is, through `registerUnclaimedTopLevel`. No in-repo stack declares `apis` inside `packages[]` (`examples/app-multi-package` declares none). Carrier: none.
- **The fallback now lists api items.** On a host-config `os serve` boot the two showcase items are in the fallback's `list('api')`. The served faces (`GET /meta/api`, `/openapi.json`) still ask `matchEndpoint` before they announce anything (`packages/rest/src/served-endpoints.ts`), so they announce nothing new.
- **Two writers on the dogfood harness.** `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack` mounts `new AppPlugin(config)` under the default registrar. The declarative-endpoint dogfood file adds an artifact-door `MetadataPlugin` through `extraPlugins`. On that harness `api` now has two registrars, as the four security collections already do. The two items are equal (the byte-comparable pin), and the file stays 17/17 green. Carrier: none.
- **The config module's items carry the stamp.** This is not this change: the ObjectQL registry stamps them in place when `manifest.register` runs. A test leg asserting otherwise went red on the first run and was dropped.
